description: Source of truth for EXECUTION-LOG retention: how long a workspace's run journal is kept, per subscription plan. Consumed by the Java backend (common-lib LogRetentionPolicy, used by the orchestrator and agent purge jobs) and by the frontend pricing surfaces (lib/billing/logRetention.ts, PLAN_FEATURE_KEYS). Do NOT edit the generated files directly: edit this JSON then re-run scripts/generate-log-retention.js. WHY A CONTRACT: before this file the durations existed ONLY in the frontend (PLAN_FEATURE_KEYS plus six locale files), so a backend purge job would have hardcoded a second copy and the two would have drifted at the first pricing change, silently, with the page advertising a window the job no longer applied. RETENTION IS KEYED BY PLAN RANK, NOT BY PLAN CODE, because PlanTier ranks PAYG with STARTER, CREDIT_PACK with FREE, and all four ENTERPRISE SKUs together; keying by literal code would leave those codes unmapped, and an unmapped code must never be guessed. An unmapped or unresolvable plan retains FOREVER (days = null): this job deletes, so it fails LONG, unlike the revenue gate in PlanFeatureGate which fails open. That asymmetry is deliberate. Retention covers the execution journal only (step data, skipped-node and step-output JSON payloads, agent execution messages and tool calls). It never covers files (any storage row carrying an s3_key), chat history (conversation.tool_results), or the credit ledger.

tiers.note: CREDIT_PACK shares this rank: a one-off top-up is not a plan.
PAYG shares this rank: paying per call is not a tier upgrade.
Raised from 60 to 90 days (3 months) by product decision 2026-09-01.
Contractual, per-organization. Null means retain until an explicit override says otherwise; all four ENTERPRISE_* SKUs share rank 4.

noSubscriptionNote: PlanLimitService.loadPlanCode returns the SAME __NONE__ sentinel for 'account found, no active subscription' and for 'account not found', so the sentinel cannot be read as FREE: an unidentifiable tenant would be handed the SHORTEST window and have its journal erased, which is the August 2026 id-form incident turned destructive. The FREE window is therefore applied only on a POSITIVELY identified free account, i.e. when the resolver sends the literal plan code FREE. Anything ambiguous retains.
